candidates.issue_year_matches_sources: Yes. The issue page states Green Lantern: War Journal #1 has a cover date of November, 2023 and was published on September 19, 2023; League of Comic Geeks also lists it as Sep 19, 2023 / Nov 2023.
candidates.reprint_check: Not a reprint magazine. This is a standard original comic issue, not a reprint of another US issue.
candidates.subject_main_in_issue: Yes. John Stewart is the featured/main character of Green Lantern: War Journal #1, and the Ellie construct appears in the issue as part of his story, not a passing cameo.
candidates.verbatim_sentence: Not wishing to confront her with the truth, John created a construct of Ellie to keep her company.

content.notes: The claim is supported exactly by the issue/character recap material: John Stewart creates a construct of his dead sister Ellie to keep his mother company in Green Lantern: War Journal #1. JOHN STEWART RETURNS IN AN EPIC NEW SERIES FROM THE PAGES OF GREEN LANTERN! John Stewart's time as a Green Lantern has come to an end…or so he thinks. A family tragedy calls him back home, and as John begins to reclaim the career he once left behind, he tries to embrace a peaceful post-superhero life. But when a terrifying and contagious force with a mysterious connection to Oa appears on Earth, the last Green Lantern of another Universe comes seeking the only warrior to face this threat and win: the immortal "Guardian and Builder," John Stewart himself!
Can this brilliant but brash young Lantern help John discover the qualities that made him one of the greatest Lanterns of the entire Multiverse? Featuring the first appearance of an iconic and terrifying new villain!

# Eleanor Stewart (Prime Earth)
**Eleanor "Ellie" Stewart** was the younger sister of John Stewart. During the war against the Revenant Queen, Ellie was brought back into existence as a living Spectrum construct.
## History
Eleanor passed away when she was a child. Decades later Eleanor's mother became senile and forgot that Eleanor was dead. Not wishing to confront her with the truth, John created a construct of Ellie to keep her company.
## Notes
- Eleanor Stewart was created by Phillip Kennedy Johnson and Fernando Blanco, first appearing in *Dark Crisis: Worlds Without a Justice League - Green Lantern* #1. However, Eleanor Stewart first appeared as part of Prime Earth continuity in *Green Lantern: War Journal* #1 by Phillip Kennedy Johnson and Montos.
